name: Haus Steinrösl
beschreibung: The Gasthof Haus Steinrösl is located in a rural area of Tirol. The guest rooms are simply and functionally furnished. In the dining room, regional dishes are served. A guest garden is available during the summer months. The surroundings are characterized by mountains and forests. Guests use the house as a starting point for hikes or ski trips. The establishment places value on unobtrusive, traditional hospitality.
